title: Execution
description: Intent to run a Plan with specific bindings. Spec is immutable after creation; status tracks progress.

executionSpec.description: Specification of the execution (immutable after creation)

goalRef.description: Reference to the goal this execution serves (optional; Plan may already reference Goal)

planRef.description: Reference to the plan to execute

bindingRef.description: Default binding to use for capability resolution

nodeBindings.description: Per-node binding overrides. Key is node ID (must match graph.nodes[].id), value is Binding reference.

parameters.description: Execution parameters. Use reverse-domain keys (e.g., 'io.planspec.*') or 'x-' prefix for experimental.

context.description: Contextual attachments (notes, code pointers, structured data)

executionStatus.description: Status of the execution (mutable by controllers)

runId.description: Unique identifier for this run. Set once at creation; defaults to metadata.uid if not specified. One Execution = one run.

message.description: Human-readable message explaining current phase or failure

queuedTime.description: RFC3339 timestamp when controller acknowledged the execution. Queue latency = queuedTime - metadata.creationTimestamp.

startTime.description: RFC3339 timestamp when execution started running (first node began). Startup latency = startTime - queuedTime.

lastPhaseTransitionTime.description: RFC3339 timestamp when phase last changed

specHash.description: Hash of spec at creation time. Controllers can refuse to run if spec changes. Format: algorithm:digest (e.g., 'sha256:abc123...').

nodeStatuses.description: Status per node ID. Keys must match graph.nodes[].id from the referenced Plan. Controllers may omit nodes not yet materialized or include all nodes with phase 'Pending'.

observedGeneration.description: The generation observed by the controller

extensions.description: Extension fields for forward compatibility (controller, runner info, etc.)

nodeStatus.description: Status of a node within an execution

startTime.description: RFC3339 timestamp when node execution started

completionTime.description: RFC3339 timestamp when node execution completed

attempt.description: Current attempt number. 0 = not yet attempted, 1+ = attempt count.

outputs.description: Outputs produced by the node. Use reverse-domain keys (e.g., 'io.planspec.*') or 'x-' prefix for experimental/custom keys.

extensions.description: Extension fields for forward compatibility (agentId, workerId, logs, timings, etc.)

path.description: Path to the artifact relative to the execution artifact root (controller-defined). Required for file/directory types.

url.description: URL to the artifact (required for url type)

checksum.description: Checksum for verification (format: algorithm:digest, e.g., sha256:abc123)

mediaType.description: MIME type of the artifact content (e.g., 'application/json')
